name: shooter2d
description: Top-down multiplayer shooter: Rust lobby and gameservers talking WebRTC to a TypeScript client

scripts.build: pnpm -r run build && cargo build --release -p lobby -p gameserver
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:wasm && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:wasm && tsc -p scripts && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm -r run test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.protocol:types: cargo test -p protocol --features ts-export export_bindings && oxfmt apps/client/src/protocol
